editorial_thesis: Agents are moving from isolated demos to governed operating surfaces: portable harnesses, identity-bound access, and repeatable evaluation.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Development Environments
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The developer surface is becoming a replaceable control layer: choose an agent harness, allocate enough isolated disk, and keep external connectors behind explicit ownership. That makes experimentation portable without making authority portable by accident.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot in AI SDK harness
sources.why_selected: The application can switch among Copilot, Claude Code, Cline, Codex, Cursor, and others without rewriting orchestration.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a Buildn agent runner with a stable adapter boundary and provider-specific trials.

sources.title: Vercel Sandbox: 64 GB default
sources.why_selected: Disk pressure is a hidden limit for dependency-heavy agents, build artifacts, and data workloads that spill to disk.
sources.usefulness: Give client code agents reproducible build sandboxes without treating the mutable runtime as production.

sources.title: Connector Manager permissions
sources.why_selected: Connector administration is a control-plane action, not a convenience setting.
sources.usefulness: Separate people who build agents from people who authorize external-system reach.

sources.title: Visual Studio September Insiders
sources.why_selected: Agents need repository context and fast recovery, not only a chat panel.
sources.usefulness: Use the File System view and fail-fast builds as a checklist for agent-ready IDE workflows.

topic_groups.title: Agent Security Control Plane
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Today’s security signal is operational rather than rhetorical: agents need user-bound OAuth, site owners need declared content terms, and infrastructure teams need to test protocol changes against real transport constraints.

sources.title: Managed OAuth for Cloudflare Access
sources.why_selected: It replaces shared service credentials with a user–agent relationship and an auditable authorization flow.
sources.usefulness: Put a client wiki or internal tool behind an identity-aware boundary before adding an agent interface.

sources.title: 1.1.1.1 post-quantum DNSSEC
sources.why_selected: The practical issue is migration engineering: PQ signatures are much larger and must coexist with conventional algorithms.
sources.usefulness: Add DNS and certificate-chain dependencies to Buildn availability and future cryptography reviews.

sources.title: Agentic Internet bot report
sources.why_selected: Client content now needs an explicit machine-access posture, not only SEO and analytics.
sources.usefulness: Offer a Buildn preflight covering agent discoverability, crawler terms, paid access, and referral measurement.

sources.title: Cisco AI Defense 2026.8.2
sources.why_selected: Tool inventories become stale when agents generate endpoints dynamically; discovery must observe activity and code.
sources.usefulness: Map client agent assets from source repositories and cloud activity before policy tuning.

topic_groups.title: Physical AI Evaluation + Open Tooling
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Physical AI is becoming testable as a workflow, not just a model: open models, modular simulation benchmarks, and orchestration layers now expose a path from synthetic data to repeatable evaluation.

sources.title: Cosmos and GR00T open models
sources.why_selected: Open model components make it possible to test the perception–reasoning–action boundary without training every foundation model from scratch.
sources.usefulness: Track physical-AI patterns relevant to inspection, embodied interfaces, and video-based client operations.

sources.title: Isaac Lab-Arena
sources.why_selected: Evaluation becomes a repeatable artifact instead of a bespoke demo.
sources.usefulness: Borrow its task–scenario–metric separation for agent evaluations in Buildn OS.

sources.title: NVIDIA OSMO orchestration
sources.why_selected: The scarce resource is often workflow coordination and provenance, not model access.
sources.usefulness: Use the pattern for multi-stage client automation with explicit artifact promotion.

sources.title: Cosmos Reason 2 repository
sources.why_selected: The repo exposes a more concrete trial surface than a launch claim.
sources.usefulness: Compare its input/output contract with video search, inspection, or safety-review tasks.
